description_zh: 调用DeleteForwardEntry接口删除指定的DNAT条目
kebab_example: aliyun vpc delete-forward-entry --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --forward-table-id ftb-8vbx8xu2lqj9qb3340000 --forward-entry-id fwd-8vbn3bc8roygjp0gy0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteForwardEntry

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the NAT gateway.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
NAT网关所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DNAT table to which the DNAT entry belongs
parameters.name: forward_table_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DNAT entry to delete
parameters.name: forward_entry_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request may be different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token
